subject: Harbor Systems — assurance clarifications & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Lucille Grant <lucille.grant@harborsys.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: security@harborsys.com
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Harbor Systems SIG questionnaire and timing

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing a SIG assessment for platform vendors as part of our Q4 procurement window. Attached is our current questionnaire (Harbor_SIG_Questions_v4.xlsx) — the security team flagged a few areas where we need control-level mappings and evidence, specifically: key management, telemetry retention, and SSP scoping.

Deadline: we'd like vendor responses and evidence by EOD 31 Aug 2028. Can you confirm Redwood can provide:
- A control map tying SIG items to Redwood controls (with owners)
- Redacted SOC 2 report or attestation scope notes
- Representative telemetry samples (redacted) and guidance on retention windows
- KMS configuration screenshots or equivalent evidence

Also please highlight any scoping caveats (e.g., managed services, third-party components).

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute call later this week to walk the spreadsheet row-by-row.

Regards,
Lucille Grant
Sr. Procurement Manager — Harbor Systems
security@harborsys.com

[Attachment: Harbor_SIG_Questions_v4.xlsx]

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Systems SIG questionnaire and timing

Hi Lucille — thanks for the spreadsheet and the clear asks.

Quick confirmation: we can meet the 31 Aug turnaround for an initial evidence packet. Plan I propose:
1) Internal mapping and artifact pull (we'll surface owners and produce a control mapping spreadsheet) — delivery 18 Aug
2) Redacted SOC 2 + scope notes and sampled telemetry — delivery 21 Aug
3) KMS screenshots and short guide on key lifecycle — delivery 21 Aug
4) Final consolidated bundle (zipped) for your review — delivery 31 Aug

Cc'ing Kimberly (security lead) to own the artifact pull, and Jonas for technical clarifications.

Would you be available for a short sync Thursday (16 Aug) or Friday morning to confirm a few scoping items?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0123

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Aug 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Harbor Systems — control owners & evidence plan

Grace / Jonas / Karthik,

Following up on Grace's note — here's the internal plan and current availability of artifacts:
- Control mapping: I've started a sheet (control_mapping_2028-08-18.xlsx) and will assign owners for each SIG item. Owners: Security Ops (me) for KMS/keys, Runtime Team (Jonas) for telemetry/ingest, Platform Engineering (Karthik) for deployment boundaries.
- SOC 2: We have a redacted report (Redwood_SOC2_Report_2027_redacted.pdf) that is shareable after NDA redaction — we will remove customer names and IP addresses.
- Telemetry: We can produce a redacted sample (telemetry-sample-redacted.json) and a short note on retention windows (default 90 days, configurable for Dedicated).
- KMS: I'll capture current KMS console screenshots and a short export (kms-screenshots-2028-08-18.zip).

Action items:
- Karthik: please prepare 3 short bullet points on how we delineate responsibility when customers bring their own KMS (BYOK) vs Redwood-managed keys.
- Jonas: capture telemetry lineage and confirm what fields we can safely redact for sharing.

I'll aim to upload the control mapping and artifact stubs to the shared drive by EOD 18 Aug. If Lucille wants an earlier walkthrough, I can join the call.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

[Attachment: control_mapping_2028-08-18.xlsx]

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lucille Grant <lucille.grant@harborsys.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Aug 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Systems SIG questionnaire and timing — evidence bundle (initial)

Hi Lucille,

Per our internal sprint, attached is the initial evidence bundle and control mapping for your review:
- control_mapping_2028-08-18.xlsx — mapping of Harbor SIG rows to Redwood controls and identified owners
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2027_redacted.pdf — redacted SOC 2 attestation (PII removed)
- telemetry-sample-redacted.json — representative telemetry sample (fields redacted)

A few notes:
- Scoping: Redwood's hosted API excludes customer-managed dataflows that run entirely within customer VPCs; we've added a scoping note in the mapping (see column "scope_note").
- BYOK: Karthik has added a short excerpt in the mapping about BYOK vs Redwood-managed KMS — I'll paste his bullets below for convenience.

Karthik's BYOK excerpt:
- Customer BYOK: customer provisioned key stored in their cloud KMS; Redwood never holds raw key material; we perform envelope encryption with a customer-managed DEK.
- Redwood-managed: keys provisioned in Redwood's managed KMS; we rotate per policy and provide audit logs for key creation/rotation.
- Evidence: screenshots provided reflect Redwood-managed configuration; for BYOK we can provide configuration guidance and API call examples only.

I'm attaching the files here (zipped for the final bundle). If you'd like to do a walkthrough, we're available Friday 18:30 or Monday 20 Aug 09:00 PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

[Attachments: control_mapping_2028-08-18.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_Report_2027_redacted.pdf, telemetry-sample-redacted.json]

From: Lucille Grant <lucille.grant@harborsys.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: security@harborsys.com
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor Systems SIG questionnaire and timing — evidence bundle (initial)

Grace,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the level of detail. A few follow-ups from the security review:
- Can you confirm the retention policy for telemetry per environment (hosted vs dedicated)? Please specify any configuration flags.
- The SOC 2 redaction looks fine; can you add a short scoping note clarifying which modules (auth, telemetry, storage) were in-scope for the 2027 audit?
- For KMS evidence: the screenshots are helpful; we also need an exported audit log sample showing key rotation events (anonymized) if available.

We'd like to do the 30-minute walkthrough on Monday 20 Aug at 09:00 PT. Please invite the folks who will speak to telemetry and key rotation.

Thanks,
Lucille Grant
Sr. Procurement Manager — Harbor Systems
